A few things
before the snow.

A desktop decoration, with controls
for how much winter you want.

Can I keep working?

Yes. The desktop overlay ignores mouse clicks, so you can use your windows as usual. Pause or stop the snow from Nightfall’s settings.

Does it connect to anything?

The app runs on your device. There’s no account, analytics, remote weather service, or subscription. Your preferences save locally.

What does Homebrew install?

A prebuilt app for your Mac’s processor. Homebrew checks its SHA-256 checksum and puts Nightfall in Applications. You don’t need a compiler.

What’s still being tested?

Builds are checked on macOS and Linux. Fullscreen apps, scaled multi-monitor setups, and real Hyprland sessions still need wider runtime testing.
